house_style: Contemporary game illustration for a middle-school math arcade, like a polished indie video game: bold readable shapes, glowing molten metal, warm orange forge light against cool dark stone, subtle painted texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border.

assets.name: forge
assets.prompt: Empty background: inside a stone blacksmith forge at night, a big glowing furnace with orange fire at the back, chains and hanging tools on the dark stone walls, sparks drifting, a smooth stone floor. Leave the middle and bottom open and uncluttered. No anvil, no people.

assets.name: anvil
assets.prompt: A heavy black iron blacksmith anvil on a thick wooden stump, three-quarter view, with a warm orange rim light.

assets.name: hammer
assets.prompt: A blacksmith's hammer with a dark steel head and a worn wooden handle, lying sideways, handle to the right.

assets.name: ingot
assets.prompt: A rectangular bar of red-hot glowing orange metal, seen from the front so its big flat face points at the viewer, slightly rounded edges, glowing hot.

assets.name: coin
assets.prompt: A round shiny gold coin seen straight on, with a plain smooth face and a raised rim, no markings.

assets.name: crucible
assets.prompt: A stone crucible bowl full of glowing molten gold, three-quarter view from slightly above.
